item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Monday Meme From Scratch
item.tests: Tests turning a vague topic into one finished visual meme by choosing the imagery, joke, and readable text without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The deliverable is a finished meme image, not just a suggested caption or description.
The caption explicitly references Monday or Mondays.
The image and caption together convey an identifiable joke about Mondays, rather than a plain motivational poster.
All caption text is legible, fully inside the image, and contrasts with its background.
The visual supports the caption's joke or reaction.

turns.text: Make a meme about Mondays. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it'll cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Nothing has run, and no credits have been spent.

Here are your options:

| Option | Cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| Text-only meme here | **0 credits** | Caption you can use yourself |
| One simple 640px AI meme image using a free-plan model | **5 credits** | Cheaper, but generated lettering may be imperfect |
| Dedicated meme tool | **10 credits** | Picks a meme template and creates the meme |

Making the dedicated meme smaller or shorter won’t reduce its fixed **10-credit** cost. The cheapest image option is a single **640px image for 5 credits**, subject to your available balance.

**Free meme idea:**  
**ME:** “This week, I’m going to be productive.”  
**MONDAY:** “Let’s not get carried away.”

Would you like to keep it free, or authorize the **5-credit image**?

turns.agent:
The 5-credit image request was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was created and no credits were spent.**

Here’s the free version:

> **ME:** “This week, I’m going to be productive.”  
> **MONDAY:** “Let’s not get carried away.”

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A funny, clean internet meme, square composition, bold readable white uppercase lettering with black outline. Two stacked panels in a charming cartoon style. Top panel: an optimistic office worker with coffee looking ready to work, caption exactly: ME: THIS WEEK, I'M GOING TO BE PRODUCTIVE. Bottom panel: a smug anthropomorphic Monday calendar page lounging at a desk amid paperwork, caption exactly: MONDAY: LET'S NOT GET CARRIED AWAY. Strong visual comedy, uncluttered layout, large legible text.
